description: Blind input for the second implementation: the E1 negative case's construction, with every outcome field removed.

cases.role: bootstrap (a parser given one block as the bootstrap)
cases.construction: a no-parity bootstrap (`flags` bit 0 set, payload with no parity scheme, conformant) whose payload key 5 (`drive_compression`) is true; CRCs valid

mutation.payload: key 1 (the parity scheme) removed and key 5 (drive_compression) set to true; keys 2, 3 and 4 unchanged; deterministic encoding

integrity_repair: zero fill after the shorter payload
